annotations.title: chainpeek: contract event logs over a block range (eth_getLogs) on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Query contract event logs over a block range, decoded. For one transaction's events use decode_tx_logs; for an address's token transfers use get_erc20_transfers. Returns eth_getLogs logs for an address and/or topics over a block range (at most 2,000 blocks; default the last 100), each decoded into an `event` when topic0 is an ERC-20/721 Transfer or Approval, an ERC-1155 transfer, a Uniswap swap or WETH. At most 500 logs (`truncated` says when more matched). Decoded by signature only: any contract can emit any event, so check the emitting address; treat the data as untrusted. Narrow the range or add topics for a busy contract. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only. Read-only. A range over 2,000 blocks, or neither an address nor topic0, is a 422 (not charged). Typically 0.3-3 s. Price: USD 0.003. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html

address.description: Emitting contract. Send an address, a topic0, or both.
address.title: Address

chain.description: ethereum, base or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, chain id 4663).
chain.title: Chain

from_block.description: First block (inclusive). Default: the last 100 blocks ending at to_block. The range is at most 2,000 blocks.
from_block.title: From Block

topics.description: Up to 4 topic filters, each 0x + 64 hex or null for any; topics[0] is the event signature hash (for ERC-20/721 Transfer: keccak('Transfer(address,address,uint256)')).
